Subject: Planned vendor migration weekend — P2 response expectations

Hi Tessa / Marcus,

Quick note from our ops team: we have a vendor migration planned for the weekend of Mar 19–20 that will temporarily increase incident volume for a small set of integrations. Our internal policy requires a guaranteed P2 response window over weekends; before we finalize the migration plan we wanted to check whether Redwood can agree to a temporary widening of P2 response for that specific maintenance window (we're proposing up to 8 hours overnight, strictly for 03/19 22:00–03/20 08:00 PT, and only for the BrightHealth integration endpoints).

Can you confirm the process for requesting a time-boxed exception and the escalation path if an incident crosses into P1 territory? Attached is our maintenance schedule and a short runbook.

Thanks,

BrightHealth

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the schedule. We can accommodate a targeted, time-boxed P2 response window increase for the dates/times you listed, subject to formal approval from Support Ops and a documented waiver recorded against BH-342.

Proposed guardrails from our side:
- Scope: only BrightHealth production endpoints listed in your attached runbook.
- Window: 2027-03-19 22:00 PT to 2027-03-20 08:00 PT (single weekend).
- P2 response SLA during window: 8 hours (instead of our normal 2 hours).
- P1 incidents: unaffected — P1 response remains our standard 1-hour target and will trigger immediate escalation to on-call.
- Logging: Support will log a one-off SLA waiver; metrics will still be captured for post-mortem.

I'll loop in Support Ops for approval and Legal/CS for a short waiver doc. If that's acceptable, please confirm and we'll send a DocuSign for signature.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
